_note: Sample persona — synthetic. 14-day lifelog for the Decision Brain demo.

fields.career: Seven years as a freelance copywriter for DTC and SaaS brands: email flows, landing pages, product launches. My clients kept me because I could turn a messy founder interview into a message their customers actually repeated back. I know how to run a 45-minute discovery call and come out with a positioning line.
fields.now: Since last year three of my five retainer clients started drafting with ChatGPT and only send me "polish" jobs at a third of the rate. I've started two online courses on "AI consulting" and quit both halfway. I don't want to start from zero at 38, and I'm scared the answer is "learn to code."
fields.pull: I actually enjoy the discovery calls more than the writing itself. I've been reading about how companies write their AI prompts and most of them are terrible. I also like teaching: I ran a small email-copy workshop once and people kept asking for more.
